```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)
library(broom)
library(forcats)
library(patchwork)
library(fs)
library(ggplot2)

# Output directory for scaling figures
fs::dir_create("figures/scaling", recurse = TRUE)
```

```{r load all models}
source('helpers.R')
source('parse_tool_generations.R')
source('loadAndFormatSycophancyData.R')

# Load every available model
all_bias <- load_bias_data()
all_bias_response_by_prompt <- all_bias %>% with_baseline()
all_bias_mean_abs_diff <- all_bias_response_by_prompt %>% summarize_bias()
all_tool_calls <- load_tool_use_data()

# Attach family + size_b from the registry
attach_registry <- function(df) {
  df %>% left_join(
    models_df %>% select(model = nickname, family, size_b),
    by = "model"
  )
}

bias_for_scaling <- attach_registry(all_bias_mean_abs_diff)
tool_for_scaling <- all_tool_calls %>%
  group_by(model, prompt) %>%
  summarise(prop_tool_use = mean(tool_prob), .groups = "drop") %>%
  attach_registry()

# Family color palette (assign distinct colors per family)
family_levels <- c("Qwen2.5", "Qwen3", "Llama-3.1", "Llama-3.2", "Gemma-4", "GPT", "DeepSeek", "Gemini-2.5")
family_colors <- c(
  "Qwen2.5" = "#1F77B4",
  "Qwen3" = "#17BECF",
  "Llama-3.1" = "#D62728",
  "Llama-3.2" = "#FF9896",
  "Gemma-4" = "#2CA02C",
  "GPT" = "#7F7F7F",
  "DeepSeek" = "#9467BD",
  "Gemini-2.5" = "#FF7F0E"
)
```

```{r fig1 bias by size}
prompt_labels <- c(
  default = "Default",
  dont_discriminate = "Don't Discriminate",
  ignore = "Ignore",
  if_you_didnt_know = "If You Didn't Know",
  remove_in_context = "Remove in Context",
  removed = "Removed"
)

bias_plot_data <- bias_for_scaling %>%
  filter(!is.na(size_b),
         prompt %in% c('default','dont_discriminate','ignore','if_you_didnt_know','remove_in_context')) %>%
  mutate(prompt = factor(prompt, levels = names(prompt_labels)),
         family = factor(family, levels = family_levels))

# Reference lines from closed-source / NA-size models (drawn as horizontal dashes)
bias_ref <- bias_for_scaling %>%
  filter(is.na(size_b),
         prompt %in% c('default','dont_discriminate','ignore','if_you_didnt_know','remove_in_context')) %>%
  mutate(prompt = factor(prompt, levels = names(prompt_labels)))

fig1 <- ggplot(bias_plot_data,
               aes(x = size_b, y = mean_abs_diff, color = family, group = family)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_abs_diff - se_abs_diff,
                    ymax = mean_abs_diff + se_abs_diff),
                width = 0.05, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(data = bias_ref, aes(yintercept = mean_abs_diff, color = family),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ prompt, labeller = labeller(prompt = prompt_labels), nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = family_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Model size (billion parameters, log scale)",
    y = "Mean absolute difference from true blindness",
    color = "Family"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave('figures/scaling/fig1_bias_by_size.png', fig1, height = 4, width = 14, dpi = 300)
fig1
```

```{r fig3 tool de-biases by size}
# Marginal response after self-call: use load_tool_response_data + pivot,
# build the marginal_pyes via the same logic as analysis_4
combined_resp_df <- load_tool_response_data() %>% pivot_conditional_logits()

removed_pyes_df <- all_bias %>%
  filter(prompt == 'removed') %>%
  mutate(removed_pyes = exp(response) / (1 + exp(response))) %>%
  select(model, vignette, race, gender, removed_pyes)

after_self_call_df <- combined_resp_df %>%
  filter(tool_desc == 'run counterfactual simulation',
         prompt %in% c('default','dont_discriminate','ignore','if_you_didnt_know','remove_in_context')) %>%
  mutate(after_self_call_pyes = exp(yes_logit) / (exp(yes_logit) + exp(no_logit))) %>%
  select(model, vignette, race, gender, prompt, model_response, after_self_call_pyes)

marginal_response_data <- removed_pyes_df %>%
  inner_join(after_self_call_df, by = c("model", "vignette", "race", "gender")) %>%
  group_by(model, vignette, race, gender, prompt) %>%
  summarise(
    removed_pyes = first(removed_pyes),
    after_self_call_yes = after_self_call_pyes[model_response == 'Yes'][1],
    after_self_call_no  = after_self_call_pyes[model_response == 'No'][1],
    marginal_pyes = removed_pyes * after_self_call_yes + (1 - removed_pyes) * after_self_call_no,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(marginal_pyes), marginal_pyes > 0, marginal_pyes < 1) %>%
  mutate(
    marginal_response = log(marginal_pyes) - log(1 - marginal_pyes),
    removed_response  = log(removed_pyes)  - log(1 - removed_pyes)
  )

# Mean absolute deviation of the marginal (post-self-call) response from true blindness
marginal_summary <- marginal_response_data %>%
  group_by(model, prompt) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_abs_diff_marginal = mean(abs(marginal_response - removed_response)),
    se_abs_diff_marginal = sd(abs(marginal_response - removed_response)) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  attach_registry() %>%
  mutate(prompt = factor(prompt, levels = names(prompt_labels)),
         family = factor(family, levels = family_levels))

marginal_plot_data <- marginal_summary %>% filter(!is.na(size_b))
marginal_ref <- marginal_summary %>% filter(is.na(size_b))

fig3 <- ggplot(marginal_plot_data,
               aes(x = size_b, y = mean_abs_diff_marginal, color = family, group = family)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_abs_diff_marginal - se_abs_diff_marginal,
                    ymax = mean_abs_diff_marginal + se_abs_diff_marginal),
                width = 0.05, linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_hline(data = marginal_ref, aes(yintercept = mean_abs_diff_marginal, color = family),
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ prompt, labeller = labeller(prompt = prompt_labels), nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = family_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Model size (billion parameters, log scale)",
    y = "Mean absolute difference from true blindness\n(after self-call)",
    color = "Family"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave('figures/scaling/fig3_tool_de_biases.png', fig3, height = 4, width = 14, dpi = 300)
fig3
```

```{r fig4 sycophancy by size}
sycophancy_summary <- combined_sycophancy %>%
  group_by(model, prompt) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_response = mean(response - removed_response),
    se_response = sd(response - removed_response) / sqrt(n()),
    mean_marginal = mean(marginal_response - removed_response, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_marginal = sd(marginal_response - removed_response, na.rm = TRUE) /
                  sqrt(sum(!is.na(marginal_response))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  attach_registry()

sycophancy_summary <- sycophancy_summary %>%
  mutate(family = factor(family, levels = family_levels))

syc_plot_data <- sycophancy_summary %>% filter(!is.na(size_b))
syc_ref <- sycophancy_summary %>% filter(is.na(size_b))

# We plot the absolute sycophancy magnitude (|response - removed_response|) summarized to row level above.
# For a more informative scaling figure: show original sycophancy (response - removed) and the
# self-call-mitigated marginal sycophancy as separate panels per prompt.
syc_long <- syc_plot_data %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(mean_response, mean_marginal),
               names_to = "intervention",
               values_to = "sycophancy") %>%
  mutate(intervention = recode(intervention,
                               "mean_response" = "Original",
                               "mean_marginal" = "After self-call"))

fig4 <- ggplot(syc_long,
               aes(x = size_b, y = sycophancy, color = family, linetype = intervention,
                   group = interaction(family, intervention))) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "gray70", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ prompt, nrow = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(values = family_colors, drop = FALSE) +
  labs(
    x = "Model size (billion parameters, log scale)",
    y = "Sycophancy (response − blinded response)",
    color = "Family",
    linetype = "Condition"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave('figures/scaling/fig4_sycophancy.png', fig4, height = 4, width = 14, dpi = 300)
fig4
```
